subject: Quick POC addendum: microcredit surge + short extension proposal
messages:
From: Amy Turner <amy@brightline.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 7 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: short extension or microcredit bucket?

Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We are seeing a spike in ingestion while the data team finalizes a normalization script, and the current 30-day POC is likely to exhaust the token budget mid-next week. Two asks from our side: 1) Can we add a short extension (7-14 days) to the current pilot, and 2) alternatively, can we purchase a small surge credit pack (microcredits) that would only be billed if used?

Our procurement prefers a credit bucket to an official term extension, but the engineering team wants guaranteed access in case the script causes unexpected bursts. Can you outline both options and high-level pricing? Also need any amendment wording we should send to legal for review.

Amy
Amy Turner
Head of Data Platforms, Brightline Systems
amy@brightline.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Turner <amy@brightline.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 7 Mar 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short extension or microcredit bucket?

Hi Amy,

Appreciate the heads-up. Two pragmatic paths we usually offer for this exact scenario:

- 7-day extension at no charge plus a 10% concession on any additional paid timeboxed addendum if you convert to a paid pilot within 30 days. This keeps a hard cap on cost and preserves current pilot configs.
- Microcredit surge bucket: 50k token-equivalent microcredit pack priced at 0.09 USD per 1k tokens (billed only if used). This prevents process changes from blocking you while keeping accounting simple.

For Brightline, I can put together a hybrid (small microcredit pack + a 7-day safety extension) which our finance team can pre-approve as a one-off. Looping in Lauren and Marissa for pricing confirmation and to attach a draft amendment for legal.

If that sounds OK I will send a formal quote and DocuSign link. What is your procurement lead's email so we can include them in the quote?

Thanks,
Jordan
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>

Jordan and Amy,

Pricing confirmation from finance and legal ops: we can do a hybrid proposal under the following terms for this POC only (exception request attached and submitted to marissa for final approval).

Option hybrid (recommended):
- 7 calendar day extension to the current time-boxed pilot, effective from current end date.
- 50k microcredit pack (token-equivalent) at a bundled rate of 0.085 USD per 1k tokens (5.5% discount on standard microcredits).
- If Brightline converts to a paid commitment within 30 days of the amended end date, we will credit 25% of the microcredit spend toward the first monthly invoice.

Attached: BRI-POC-Amendment-draft.pdf (tracks the language legal usually requires).

Marissa, can you confirm authority to approve this one-off concession (finance memo attached internally)? If you want, I can lower the microcredit price slightly but will need Marissa to sign off.

Amy, please send procurement contact for an official quote and any PO routing requirements.

Best,
Lauren
